decisive_items: plump spindle cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, fragments of collagenous matrix
firm to hard without changes in the overlying skin
The spindle cells had bipolar cytoplasmic extensions and round-to-oval nuclei with fine granular chromatin; nucleoli were inconspicuous.
response.rationale: The champion candidate, Fibromatosis, is supported by the presence of plump spindle cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and fragments of collagenous matrix, as well as the firmness of the lesions without changes in the overlying skin. The runner-up candidate, Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, is also supported by some cytological features, but the lack of necrosis and inflammatory cells is not typical. The decisive items highlight the characteristic features of fibromatosis, while the counterfactual missing items suggest that other diagnoses, such as dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, are less likely due to the absence of certain features.

rejected.why: lack of necrosis and inflammatory cells is not typical
firmness of the lesions is not typical of lipomatosis
neurofibroma is less likely due to the absence of specific features such as lymphadenopathy
